scenario: [LGRA.15.8] — "Unknown escape is a compile error", exercised. A compiler that passes `\q` through as a literal `q` fails this. `\q` is not in _ESCAPE_MAP (\\ " n t r 0) nor a numeric introducer (x u U), so it is the unknown case rather than a malformed known one. Asserts the specific diagnostic, not merely non-OK — a vector that accepts any error passes against a compiler rejecting this for the wrong reason, e.g. a lexer that choked on the backslash before ever classifying the escape.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    log info "bad \q escape"
